verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents its own scenario modeling feature, which covers hypothetical future rounds, exportable scenarios, and Internal Rate of Return and cash-on-cash calculations. Those return metrics suggest some exit-proceeds modeling per investor, but no evidence explicitly describes an exit waterfall. Missing for 10: explicit exit waterfall analysis, proceeds broken out per share class and stakeholder, modeling across varying exit values, handling of liquidation preferences and participation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
